title_en: Duffy's $50 billion request gets chilly reception from Senate GOP
title_zh: 达菲的 500 亿美元请求遭到参议院共和党的冷遇
summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's $50 billion request to overhaul the nation's air traffic control system is getting a chilly reception from Senate Republicans, who are balking at the hefty price tag. Why it matters: The pushback from within President Trum
summary_zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 提出的 500 亿美元彻底改革国家空中交通管制系统的请求遭到了参议院的冷遇
body_en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's $50 billion request to overhaul the nation's air traffic control system is getting a chilly reception from Senate Republicans, who are balking at the hefty price tag.
Why it matters: The pushback from within President Trump's own party casts doubt on the administration's ability to secure the full $50 billion, even after Friday's historic nationwide groundstop .

Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) told reporters that Duffy "made a huge mistake" by originally requesting $30 billion for air traffic modernization, then later upping the ask to $50 billion following the groundstop.

"Maybe he was taking orders, but he's smart enough to know better than to say, 'I need 30 billion. We have a catastrophe. I need 50 billion now.'" Kennedy said, adding, "We're not going to give them $50 billion."
Both Duffy and Trump have urged Congress to move quickly on the funding, which the administration formally requested Tuesday.

Driving the news: Duffy, along with FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford, pitched the funding — which include $10 billion specifically for air traffic equipment modernization — to Senate Republicans at their weekly lunch.
"I don't think the full $50 billion will be funded. Some of that is not safety related," Commerce Chairman Ted Cruz (R-Texas) told reporters.

Cruz floated using the fast-track reconciliation process to secure additional funding for upgrading the air traffic control system, but said the administration needs to show it can effectively spend the $12.5 billion Congress already provided in the " Big, Beautiful Bill " last year.
"Demonstrate that you can actually modernize, and come back to Congress when you need additional funds," Cruz said.
Zoom in: Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-S.D.) has also raised concerns about the unspent funds.
"There's some explanations that have to be given as to why that number is where it is," Thune told reporters Monday.
Thune poured cold water on using reconciliation to pass the additional funds, instead saying he would like to work with Democrats through the normal appropriations process.

But Democrats are also expressing skeptcism about the funding request, with Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) saying Monday: "We want to give them all the money they need, but they've got to use it, and know how to implement it — and they don't."
The intrigue : Some Republicans want the airline industry and other users of the system to pick up more of the tab.
"I don't understand why the airline industry doesn't pay for it. We've given them unbelievable amounts of money," Sen. Rick Scott (R-Fla.) told reporters.
"One of the things that you could do is make the people who actually use it pay for it, just like they have user landing fees," Sen. Jon Husted (R-Ohio) said.

"I think in a nation with a $40 trillion national debt and $2 trillion annual deficits, that we're going to have to find ways to make the people who are using the services pay for the services," Husted added.
body_zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 提出的 500 亿美元彻底改革国家空中交通管制系统的请求遭到了参议院共和党人的冷遇，他们对高昂的价格犹豫不决。
重要性：来自特朗普总统所在政党内部的反对让人们对政府是否有能力获得全额 500 亿美元的资金产生了怀疑，即使是在周五历史性的全国性停赛之后。
参议员约翰·肯尼迪（路易斯安那州共和党人）告诉记者，达菲“犯了一个巨大的错误”，他最初要求 300 亿美元用于空中交通现代化，后来在地面停留后将要求提高到 500 亿美元。
“也许他是在接受命令，但他足够聪明，知道不能说‘我需要 300 亿美元。我们遇到了灾难。我现在需要 500 亿美元。’”肯尼迪补充道，“我们不会给他们 500 亿美元。”
达菲和特朗普都敦促国会迅速采取行动，政府周二正式要求提供资金。
推动这一消息的是：达菲和美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德 (Bryan Bedford) 在参议院共和党人每周的午餐会上向他们推销了这笔资金，其中包括专门用于空中交通设备现代化的 100 亿美元。
“我认为不会提供全部 500 亿美元资金。其中一些与安全无关，”商务主席特德·克鲁兹（德克萨斯州共和党人）告诉记者。
克鲁兹提出利用快速和解程序来确保升级空中交通管制系统的额外资金，但他表示，政府需要证明它可以有效地使用国会去年在“大而美丽的法案”中提供的 125 亿美元。
克鲁兹说：“证明你实际上可以实现现代化，并在需要额外资金时回到国会。”
放大：参议院多数党领袖约翰·图恩（R-S.D.）也对未动用的资金表示担忧。
图恩周一对记者表示：“对于为什么这个数字是现在这个样子，必须给出一些解释。”
图恩对利用和解来通过额外资金的做法泼了一盆冷水，而是表示他希望通过正常的拨款程序与民主党合作。
但民主党人也对资金请求表示怀疑，参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默（纽约州民主党人）周一表示：“我们想给他们所需的所有资金，但他们必须使用这些资金，并知道如何实施——但他们不这样做。”
阴谋：一些共和党人希望航空业和该系统的其他用户承担更多的费用。
“我不明白为什么航空业不为此买单。我们给了他们令人难以置信的巨额资金，”佛罗里达州共和党参议员里克·斯科特告诉记者。
“你可以做的一件事就是让实际使用它的人付费，就像他们收取用户登陆费一样，”参议员乔恩·赫斯特德（俄亥俄州共和党）说。
赫斯特德补充道：“我认为，在一个拥有 40 万亿美元国债和 2 万亿美元年度赤字的国家，我们必须找到方法让使用服务的人们为服务付费。”

title_en: Chargers show enough progress on offense to finally end 11-game losing streak
title_zh: 闪电队在进攻上取得了足够的进步，最终结束了11连败
summary: The Los Angeles Chargers’ fundamental issues on offense did not go away because of a 23-20 win at the Baltimore Ravens, but they probably feel a lot more manageable after ending a losing streak that dates back to last December
summary_zh: 洛杉矶闪电队在进攻上的基本问题并没有因为 23-20 战胜巴尔的摩乌鸦队而消失，但他们可能感觉很多
body_en: The Los Angeles Chargers’ fundamental issues on offense did not go away because of a 23-20 win at the Baltimore Ravens, but they probably feel a lot more manageable after ending a losing streak that dates back to last December

EL SEGUNDO, Calif. -- The Los Angeles Chargers’ fundamental issues on offense did not go away because of a 23-20 win at the Baltimore Ravens , but they probably feel a lot more manageable after ending a losing streak that dates back to last December.

With the specter of becoming the NFL’s first 0-17 team gone, their focus over the eight remaining games must be figuring out what players, coaches and traits should carry over to 2027 and what needs to change in the offseason.
The Chargers (1-8) did finally address some of the longstanding issues that sank a campaign which started with massive expectations.

The running back rotation was finally scuttled, letting 2025 first-round pick Omarion Hampton get the bulk of the work. He turned 22 carries into 105 yards rushing and a touchdown on Monday night. It was Hampton’s second career 100-yard game, and he did it with the second-highest workload of his professional tenure.

Consistent success with the ground game took pressure off battered quarterback Justin Herbert, who attempted a season-low 18 passes. Without needing to carry the team, he looked refreshed and as confident as he has all year.

Herbert ended up 12 of 18 for 129 yards, but he took just two sacks and added 51 yards rushing with a touchdown. Most importantly, he avoided giving the ball away, allowing the Chargers to win the turnover margin for the second time all season.
That shift is what the hiring of offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel was supposed to accomplish. He also highlighted unheralded pieces of the roster.
Second-year receiver Tre Harris helped out as Herbert’s main target, finishing with a career-high 86 yards on five receptions. An offensive line starting three rookies fared well.

None of those performances make up for what happened before, nor do they address fundamental questions still hanging over the organization, such as the lack of difference-making passing game options around Herbert, whether the quarterback will ever fully adapt to the quick timing offense McDaniel is trying to run, or what to do with left tackle Rashawn Slater coming off a third injury-shortened season in six years.
But a win is a win. After 11 straight losses including the playoffs, that counts for something.

Defensive coordinator Chris O’Leary had his group locked in to stop the run, allowing 16 yards on 15 carries. The Chargers held Derrick Henry to 10 yards on 10 attempts, the second-worst output of his Hall of Fame-caliber career with at least 10 carries; Henry finished with nine yards on 16 carries with the Tennessee Titans against the Houston Texans in December 2023.

The pass defense has sprung a leak over the past two games. Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards in his first start for the Ravens on the heels of C.J. Stroud’s 384 yards and five touchdowns in Week 9. Upcoming games against the New York Jets and New England Patriots without an injured Drake Maye should offer a reprieve, but the drop-off is concerning.

FB Scott Matlock. It isn’t a coincidence that success running the ball came with Matlock playing a season-high 49.1% of the Chargers’ offensive snaps. He brings a physical edge, as demonstrated when Matlock pulled Hampton over the goal line late in the first half.
RB Keaton Mitchell had three carries for four yards and got lucky when a teammate recovered his fumbled kickoff return early in the second quarter.
WR Ladd McConkey didn’t travel with the team after his back injury flared up. … TE Oronde Gadsden II was able to come back after getting poked in the eye.

随着成为 NFL 首支 0-17 球队的幽灵消失，他们在剩下的 8 场比赛中的重点必须是弄清楚哪些球员、教练和特质应该延续到 2027 年，以及休赛期需要改变什么。
闪电队（1-8）终于解决了一些长期存在的问题，这些问题导致了一场在人们寄予厚望的情况下开始的比赛失败。
跑卫轮换最终被取消，让 2025 年首轮秀奥马里恩·汉普顿 (Omarion Hampton) 承担了大部分工作。周一晚上，他冲球 22 码，冲球达阵 105 码。这是汉普顿职业生涯第二场 100 码比赛，他完成了职业生涯第二高的工作量。
地面比赛的持续成功减轻了饱受打击的四分卫贾斯汀·赫伯特的压力，他尝试了赛季最低的 18 次传球。不需要带领球队，他看起来神清气爽，像一整年一样自信。
赫伯特最终 18 中 12 推进 129 码，但他只被擒杀两次，并冲球达阵 51 码。最重要的是，他避免了丢球，让闪电队整个赛季第二次赢得了失误率。
这种转变正是聘请进攻协调员迈克·麦克丹尼尔本应实现的。他还强调了名单中不为人知的部分。
二年级接球手特雷·哈里斯 (Tre Harris) 成为赫伯特的主要目标，五次接球取得职业生涯最高的 86 码。由三名新秀首发的进攻线表现出色。
这些表现都无法弥补之前发生的事情，也没有解决仍然困扰该组织的基本问题，例如赫伯特周围缺乏改变的传球选择，四分卫是否能够完全适应麦克丹尼尔试图跑动的快速进攻，或者如何处理六年来第三个因伤缩短的赛季的左截锋拉肖恩·斯莱特。
但胜利就是胜利。在包括季后赛在内的11连败之后，这很有意义。
防守协调员克里斯·奥利里 (Chris O’Leary) 阻止了球队的跑动，15 次冲球仅允许 16 码。闪电队在 10 次尝试中将德里克·亨利 (Derrick Henry) 限制在 10 码内，这是他名人堂级别职业生涯中至少 10 次冲球的第二差输出； 2023 年 12 月，亨利随田纳西泰坦队对阵休斯顿德州人队，16 次冲球取得 9 码。

title_en: LIV players offered a European tour lifeline. Those left off the list are just as notable
title_zh: LIV 球员提供了欧洲巡回赛的生命线。那些未列入名单的人同样值得注意
summary: Patching back the golf landscape in the wake of LIV Golf is not an easy fix
summary_zh: LIV Golf 后修复高尔夫格局并非易事
body_en: Patching back the golf landscape in the wake of LIV Golf is not an easy fix
Even as LIV Golf is winding down through bankruptcy , the players are more compelling now than when they were actually competing.

Remember when all the speculation was who would leave the PGA Tour and European tour? Now it's who's allowed to return. The list of LIV players with nowhere to go is as notable as those offered a European tour lifeline by agreeing to a set number of sponsor invitations.
Longtime supporters of the European tour railed about sending 10 players to the PGA Tour each year, and now it gets banned PGA Tour players with a greater profile than those they were losing.
This might take longer to sort out than LIV Golf's bankruptcy proceedings.

“There has been significant change in the landscape of men’s professional golf over the past 12 months,” said Guy Kinnings, the chief executive of the European tour. “As golf’s global tour, we have taken a pragmatic approach to this unique and unprecedented situation as we go into next year, always with the best interests of our entire membership at the forefront of our minds.”
It's sure to raise eyebrows across several fronts, starting with the European tour offering sponsor invitations without a hefty appearance fee to nine players who never contributed to the tour.

All of them added to the “significant change in the landscape” by defecting from their tours to join a rival league with a seemingly endless supply of Saudi cash until it disappeared quicker than anyone can say “Strait of Hormuz."
The idea behind the offer was to place them in European tour stops that needed help, giving those tournaments a boost in star power without taking away a spot from fields that were depleted anyway.

Some players were afforded European tour status already earned, whether it was Bryson DeChambeau (2024 U.S. Open champion) and Tyrrell Hatton (Rolex Series winner) or Paul Casey (career money) and David Puig (tournament winner).

The nine players who signed agreements for a specific number of sponsor invitations — and it varies among the players — include major champions Dustin Johnson, Bubba Watson and Cameron Smith. Those players, along with Joaquin Niemann, are the reason Kinnings said, “Our 2027 season is set to be one of the most keenly contested campaigns in our 55-year history.”
No doubt, it's a big move for the European tour and the most practical one considering the PGA Tour still has a one-year ban from a player's last appearance on LIV.
Still to be determined are the stakes for ex-LIV players.

The PGA Tour's alliance with Europe expires next year. PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp said Monday evening they are having productive discussions and “both entities have a mutual desire to extend and modify our partnership.”

The modification is likely to include how many PGA Tour cards are offered the leading players in Europe, but it is most certain to be fewer than 10. That shouldn't be an issue for Johnson, whose 24 tour wins make him a lifetime PGA Tour member. But it would be for the likes of Niemann, Carlos Ortiz, Abraham Ancer and Lucas Herbert.
Also unclear is how many tournaments DeChambeau, in the highest priority category as Europe's newest member, chooses to play beyond the minimum required.
body_zh: LIV Golf 后修复高尔夫格局并非易事
尽管 LIV Golf 因破产而陷入困境，但球员们现在比他们真正参加比赛时更具吸引力。
还记得当时所有的猜测都是谁将离开美巡赛和欧洲巡回赛吗？现在是谁被允许返回。无处可去的 LIV 球员名单与那些通过同意一定数量的赞助商邀请而获得欧洲巡回赛生命线的球员名单一样引人注目。
欧洲巡回赛的长期支持者抱怨每年派出 10 名球员参加美巡赛，现在美巡赛被禁赛的球员比他们失去的球员还要多。
这可能比 LIV Golf 的破产程序需要更长的时间来解决。
“过去12个月里，男子职业高尔夫的格局发生了重大变化，”欧洲巡回赛首席执行官盖伊·金宁斯(Guy Kinnings)表示。 “作为高尔夫的全球巡回赛，我们在进入明年时采取了务实的态度来应对这一独特且前所未有的情况，始终将我们全体会员的最大利益放在首位。”
这肯定会引起多方面的关注，首先是欧洲巡回赛向从未为巡回赛做出贡献的九名球员提供赞助商邀请，而无需支付高额出场费。
他们所有人都从巡回赛中叛逃，加入了一个拥有源源不断的沙特现金的竞争对手联盟，这加剧了“景观的重大变化”，直到它以比任何人都可以说的“霍尔木兹海峡”更快的速度消失。
这一提议背后的想法是将他们安排在需要帮助的欧洲巡回赛站点，从而增强这些赛事的明星力量，同时又不会从已经耗尽的场地中夺走一个席位。
一些球员已经获得了欧洲巡回赛的资格，无论是布莱森·德尚博（2024 年美国公开赛冠军）和泰瑞尔·哈顿（劳力士系列赛冠军）还是保罗·凯西（职业生涯奖金）和大卫·普伊格（锦标赛冠军）。
签署了特定数量赞助商邀请协议的九名球员（球员之间的情况各不相同）包括大满贯冠军达斯汀·约翰逊、巴巴·沃森和卡梅隆·史密斯。这些球员以及华金·尼曼 (Joaquin Niemann) 正是金宁斯所说的原因：“我们的 2027 赛季将成为我们 55 年历史上竞争最激烈的赛季之一。”
毫无疑问，这对于欧洲巡回赛来说是一项重大举措，也是最实际的举措，因为美巡赛仍然对球员最后一次参加 LIV 比赛实行一年禁令。
前 LIV 球员的赌注仍有待确定。
美巡赛与欧洲的联盟将于明年到期。美巡赛首席执行官布莱恩·罗拉普 (Brian Rolapp) 周一晚上表示，他们正在进行富有成效的讨论，“双方都希望扩大和修改我们的合作伙伴关系。”

title_en: “Trump was in bed with Jensen”: Critics balk at Huang’s wish to return to Nvidia
title_zh: “特朗普与詹森上床了”：批评者对黄仁勋重返英伟达的愿望犹豫不决
summary: “I love our country”: Jensen Huang’s apology comes amid escalating Nvidia probes.
summary_zh: “我爱我们的国家”：黄仁勋的道歉是在英伟达调查不断升级之际做出的。
body_en: Size Small Standard Large Width * Standard Wide Links Standard Orange
On Monday, large trucks began circling the streets of Washington, DC, carrying billboards urging Congress to investigate the Trump administration’s ties with Nvidia’s disgraced CEO Jensen Huang.

“Jensen was in bed with a spy from China,” the billboards created by the Tech Oversight Project (TOP) alleged. “Trump was in bed with Jensen.” TOP is a nonprofit that describes itself as “dedicated to reining in Big Tech.”

Currently, Trump is supporting a campaign to bring back Huang as Nvidia’s CEO—despite many Republicans calling it a “ horrible idea. ” Breaking his silence, Huang issued a statement Tuesday saying he would be “honored” to return, but the board said reinstatement is not under consideration as an internal investigation into US spying claims remains ongoing. Huang used the moment to say that his interests align with the US’s, saying

I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. Nvidia has been my life’s work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like Nvidia be possible. I love our country, and I love Nvidia.

Trump may have learned as early as this spring that Huang was potentially the target of Chinese espionage, but the president claimed recently that he didn’t know Huang was potentially exposed to a Chinese spy as he was becoming a prominent part of Trump’s inner circle, CNN reported .

If Trump wasn’t adequately briefed, it raises question about whether the White House acted with “sufficient urgency” to address a serious espionage threat, CNN said. But if Trump is deflecting, an even “graver question” will emerge about why Trump didn’t act on information and instead continued to keep Huang close, CNN said.

Instead of distancing himself from the Nvidia CEO, Trump invited Huang to sit at the head table during a state dinner with China’s president Xi Jinping, and last month, Trump awarded Huang the National Medal of Science, the nation’s highest scientiﬁc honor, for his AI achievements.

“Not only has he continued to do nothing, he’s invited that very CEO into the White House and on state visits to China with him,” Sacha Haworth, TOP’s founder and CEO, told Ars. “And the question we all have to ask is ‘why on Earth would he do that?’”

What Trump and Nvidia knew—and when—have become central questions for some Republicans, as well as top Democrats who plan to investigate the scandal when they assume control of key committees in Congress next year. Andrew Yoon, head of research for a nonprofit called CivAI, which warns the public of dangers from AI, told Ars that Huang doesn’t need to be compromised by China to have endangered the US. Prioritizing boosting profits over national security alone is “pretty concerning.”

“I think the most notable thing here is that Jensen Huang has been at the absolute forefront of lobbying to be able to sell chips to China,” Yoon said. “He has leveraged his very deep relationships with government, especially President Trump, in order to be able to sell as many Nvidia chips to China as he can get away with. If he could be selling Blackwell chips to China, I’m sure he would be.”

Yoon noted that evidence suggests some Chinese AI models have been trained on Blackwell chips. Even with China’s push to prioritize domestic chipmakers like Huawei, Nvidia chips remain “indispensable” to China’s frontier AI goals, Yoon said. And national security experts fear that access to high-end chips will help China advance its military AI or gain economic ground.

The White House isn’t commenting on Trump’s relationship with Huang. Among the lawmakers accusing the Trump administration of “corruption” is Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.), The Wall Street Journal reported . He has already asked the White House to “preserve all communications” between Trump and Huang.

Other lawmakers are “seeking more information about what Trump knew about the relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang,” the former Megaspeed CEO whom Huang admitted to having an affair with. They also want to know more about “the administration’s failure to stop artiﬁcial-intelligence chips from going to China,” WSJ reported, and Nvidia’s reportedly $25 million donation to the White House ballroom.

“It is not just an intelligence issue; it’s also a potential corruption issue,” Blumenthal said. “There needs to be a really penetrating, comprehensive investigation of all the possible compromises of our intelligence that may have occurred, but also… that Donald Trump is so high on the head of Nvidia, and now is potentially linked to intelligence compromises.”

Trump has profited off Nvidia’s success while in office, buying “millions of dollars worth of Nvidia shares in his personal brokerage accounts since returning to oﬃce in 2025,” the WSJ reported. The White House maintains that the president has no role in managing his stock portfolio.

Other officials advising Trump on AI also benefited from relaxing export curbs, TOP said. On Tuesday, the group issued a report summarizing what the public knows about potential conflicts of interest of two Trump officials: former White House AI Czar David Sacks and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

Haworth, TOP’s founder, told Ars she’s concerned that Sacks and Lutnick abused their power to convince Trump to let Nvidia sell cutting-edge technology to China, while standing to “gain astronomical amounts of money.”

“The public is outraged by Nvidia’s CEO for compromising our national security, but we didn’t get here because of Jensen Huang’s missteps alone,” Haworth said. If “Nvidia was knowingly doing business with companies tied to illegal chip sales and smuggling with China,” then “the Trump administration was asleep at the wheel,” she said.
“White House AI Czar David Sacks and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick were protecting their own fortunes rather than looking out for Americans,” Haworth said.

技术监督项目（TOP）创建的广告牌声称，“詹森与来自中国的间谍发生了关系”。 “特朗普和詹森在床上。” TOP 是一家非营利组织，自称“致力于控制大型科技公司”。
目前，特朗普正在支持一项让黄仁勋重新担任英伟达首席执行官的运动，尽管许多共和党人称这是一个“可怕的想法”。黄仁勋周二打破沉默，发表声明称他“很荣幸”重返英伟达，但董事会表示，由于对美国间谍指控的内部调查仍在进行中，因此没有考虑恢复黄仁勋的职位。黄利用这个机会表示他的利益与美国的利益一致，并表示
53 年前我来到美国，成为美国公民是我一生中最伟大的礼物和最自豪的时刻之一。 Nvidia 是我一生的工作。与我的同事们一起将其融入到今天的公司是一种荣幸。除了美国，其他任何地方都不可能出现像英伟达这样的公司。我爱我们的国家，我也爱英伟达。
据美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道，特朗普可能早在今年春天就了解到黄可能是中国间谍活动的目标，但总统最近声称，他不知道黄可能会接触中国间谍，因为他正在成为特朗普核心圈子的重要组成部分。
美国有线电视新闻网称，如果特朗普没有得到充分的通报，就会引发人们对白宫是否“足够紧迫”地采取行动来应对严重的间谍威胁的质疑。但美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 表示，如果特朗普改变立场，就会出现一个甚至“更严重的问题”，即特朗普为何不根据信息采取行动，而是继续与黄保持密切关系。
特朗普没有与英伟达首席执行官保持距离，而是在与中国国家主席习近平举行国宴时邀请黄仁勋坐在主桌，上个月，特朗普授予黄仁勋国家科学奖章，这是美国最高的科学荣誉，以表彰他在人工智能方面的成就。
TOP 创始人兼首席执行官 Sacha Haworth 告诉 Ars：“他不仅继续无所作为，还邀请那位首席执行官进入白宫，并与他一起对中国进行国事访问。” “我们都必须问的问题是‘他到底为什么要这么做？’”
特朗普和英伟达知道什么——以及何时知道——已经成为一些共和党人和民主党高层的核心问题，他们计划在明年控制国会关键委员会时调查这一丑闻。非营利组织 CivAI 的研究负责人安德鲁·尹 (Andrew Yoon) 警告公众人工智能的危险，他告诉 Ars，黄不需要受到中国的妥协就会危及美国。将增加利润置于国家安全之上是“相当令人担忧的”。
尹说：“我认为这里最值得注意的是，黄仁勋一直处于游说的绝对前沿，以便能够向中国出售芯片。” “他利用了与政府、特别是特朗普总统的深厚关系，以便能够向中国出售尽可能多的 Nvidia 芯片。如果他可以向中国出售 Blackwell 芯片，我相信他会这么做。”
Yoon 指出，有证据表明一些中国人工智能模型已经在 Blackwell 芯片上进行了训练。尹表示，尽管中国推动优先考虑华为等国内芯片制造商，但英伟达芯片对于中国的前沿人工智能目标仍然“不可或缺”。国家安全专家担心，获得高端芯片将有助于中国推进其军事人工智能或赢得经济地位。
白宫没有对特朗普与黄的关系发表评论。据《华尔街日报》报道，康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔是指责特朗普政府“腐败”的议员之一。他已经要求白宫“保留特朗普和黄蜂之间的所有通讯”。
其他立法者正在“寻求更多信息，了解特朗普对黄仁勋和爱丽丝黄之间关系的了解”，黄仁勋承认与黄仁勋有染的前 Megaspeed 首席执行官。据《华尔街日报》报道，他们还想更多地了解“政府未能阻止人工智能芯片进入中国”，以及据报道英伟达向白宫舞厅捐赠 2500 万美元的情况。
“这不仅仅是一个情报问题；这也是一个潜在的腐败问题，”布卢门撒尔说。 “需要对我们的情报可能发生的所有可能的泄露进行真正深入、全面的调查，而且……唐纳德·特朗普在英伟达的领导地位如此之高，现在可能与情报泄露有关。”
据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普在任职期间从英伟达的成功中获利，“自 2025 年重返办公室以来，他在个人经纪账户中购买了价值数百万美元的英伟达股票”。白宫坚称总统无权管理其股票投资组合。
TOP 表示，其他为特朗普提供人工智能建议的官员也受益于放松出口限制。周二，该组织发布了一份报告，总结了公众对特朗普两名官员（前白宫人工智能沙皇大卫·萨克斯和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克）潜在利益冲突的了解。
TOP 创始人霍沃斯告诉 Ars，她担心萨克斯和卢特尼克滥用权力说服特朗普让英伟达向中国出售尖端技术，同时“赚取天文数字”。
霍沃斯表示：“公众对英伟达首席执行官损害我们国家安全的行为感到愤怒，但我们之所以没有走到这一步，是因为黄仁勋的失误。”她说，如果“英伟达故意与与非法芯片销售和向中国走私有关的公司做生意”，那么“特朗普政府就在玩忽职守”。
霍沃斯说：“白宫人工智能沙皇大卫·萨克斯和商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克是在保护自己的财富，而不是照顾美国人。”

title_en: Trump administration details its $50 billion request for aviation system improvements
title_zh: 特朗普政府详细说明了其 500 亿美元的航空系统改进请求
summary: The Trump administration has formally updated its request to lawmakers for $50.1 billion to modernize the nation's air traffic control system and to make other improvements at airports.
summary_zh: 特朗普政府已正式更新其向立法者提出的 501 亿美元的要求，用于实现国家空中交通管制系统的现代化并提高空中交通管制的效率。
body_en: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-administration-details-its-50-billion-request-for-aviation-system-improvements
The Trump administration has formally updated its request to lawmakers for $50.1 billion to modernize the nation's air traffic control system and to make other improvements at airports.

A letter to key lawmakers dated Tuesday says that less than 24 hours after the administration's request of $30.1 billion, "the urgent need for this investment became undeniable." That's when outdated equipment disrupted aircraft communications and radar feeds, forcing the Federal Aviation Administration to initiate a nationwide ground stop.

title_en: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
title_zh: 伊朗对美国海军第五舰队所在地巴林发动第三轮袭击
summary: Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.
summary_zh: 伊朗周二向美国位于巴林的雷达设施发射无人机，美国则向沿重要航运路线的伊朗目标开火进行报复。
body_en: A woman holds an Iranian flag as part of a pro-government campaign beneath a billboard depicting a launched missile, a man with a rifle, people and current and the late Revolutionary Guard missile force commanders with clenched fists, with a sign which reads in Farsi: "The sky is a place for our pride and loyalty," in downtown Tehran, Iran, Monday. Vahid Salemi/AP hide caption

CAIRO — Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar installation in Bahrain in the third Iranian attack in recent days on American military targets in the Persian Gulf island kingdom, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.

The attacks and counterattacks interrupted a roughly two-month lull in fighting, as Iran's targeting of Bahrain brought condemnations from the region. Analysts said stalled peace negotiations and Tehran's growing economic pressures were raising the risk of a substantial escalation.
What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are

Bahrain said that its air defense systems had successfully intercepted the "treacherous Iranian aerial attacks." The U.S. military likewise said the attack inflicted no damage to U.S. equipment or injury to American personnel.
Hours later, a U.S. fighter jet carried out a strike on a missile launch site in the Strait of Hormuz belonging to Iran's paramilitary Revolutionary Guard, a U.S. official said.

The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity to detail sensitive military operations, said "precision munitions" were used in the strike on Qeshm Island and that the U.S. was responding to "aggression" toward U.S. personnel.
A local official, Ahmad Nafisi, said the strike caused no damage to residential or commercial areas or infrastructure.

The U.S. military has periodically carried out what appear to be limited strikes on Qeshm Island and other Iranian targets this month. Iran's attack Tuesday was its third on American military targets in Bahrain in five days.
This is a locator map for the Gulf Cooperation Council member states: Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and United Arab Emirates. AP hide caption
Iran may be shifting its strategy amid economic pain

Iran has been suffering under a naval blockade that the U.S. has enforced on it for months in and around the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway for the world's energy supplies where Iran and its proxies have disrupted shipping since the war began Feb. 28.

U.S. President Donald Trump has been circumspect on his next steps for the Iran war, now in its eighth month despite an initial promise it would last only a matter of weeks. He has said new strikes are highly unlikely, but he has also sent a third aircraft carrier and thousands more troops to the Middle East — and told Vice President JD Vance that talks aren't needed at this time.

Oil tankers moving oil through the strait under U.S. military protection have helped return oil shipments from the Gulf to roughly prewar levels. The blockade, meanwhile, is damaging Iran's economy by curbing the flow of Iranian crude to the global market.

Iran's attacks could signal a shift in its strategy after months during which it waited for an attack and then retaliated to target the operational capability of bases, Tehran-based security analyst Mostafa Najafi told The Associated Press.
Bahrain hosts the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, which has already sustained damage in previous attacks by Iran since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

Iranian leaders will now be weighing whether "breaking the blockade through escalation is less costly than accepting its continuation," Hamidreza Azizi, senior Iran analyst at the International Crisis Group think tank, wrote in an analysis posted to X.

"In other words, the risk of renewed war no longer depends solely on whether Trump decides to attack Iran again," he said. "It also depends on whether Tehran concludes that the costs of continued restraint have become greater than the risks of escalation."

With the arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group in the region, the combined U.S. naval assets in the Persian Gulf, Arabian Sea, Red Sea, and Mediterranean now exceed the force deployed when the U.S. and Israel launched the war.
body_zh: 周一，伊朗德黑兰市中心，一名妇女举着一面伊朗国旗，这是亲政府运动的一部分，广告牌下方的广告牌上描绘了一枚已发射的导弹、一名持步枪的男子、一群人和握紧拳头的现任和已故革命卫队导弹部队指挥官，以及一块用波斯语写着的牌子：“天空是我们骄傲和忠诚的地方”。瓦希德·萨莱米/美联社隐藏标题栏
开罗——周二，伊朗向巴林的美国雷达设施发射了无人机，这是伊朗最近几天对波斯湾岛国美国军事目标的第三次袭击，美国则向一条重要航线沿线的伊朗目标开火进行报复。
这些袭击和反击打断了大约两个月的停战状态，伊朗针对巴林的袭击引起了该地区的谴责。分析人士表示，和平谈判陷入僵局以及德黑兰日益增长的经济压力正在增加局势大幅升级的风险。
特朗普现在对伊朗的战略是什么？保持事物原样
巴林表示，其防空系统已成功拦截“危险的伊朗空袭”。美国军方同样表示，这次袭击没有对美国设备造成损坏，也没有对美国人员造成伤害。
一名美国官员称，几小时后，一架美国战斗机对伊朗准军事革命卫队所属的霍尔木兹海峡导弹发射场进行了袭击。
这位不愿透露姓名的官员详细介绍了敏感的军事行动，他表示，对格什姆岛的袭击使用了“精确弹药”，美国正在对针对美国人员的“侵略”做出回应。
当地官员艾哈迈德·纳菲西 (Ahmad Nafisi) 表示，罢工没有对住宅区、商业区或基础设施造成损坏。
本月，美国军方定期对格什姆岛和其他伊朗目标进行看似有限的袭击。伊朗周二的袭击是五天内对巴林美国军事目标的第三次袭击。
这是海湾合作委员会成员国的定位地图：沙特阿拉伯、巴林、卡塔尔、阿曼、科威特和阿拉伯联合酋长国。美联社隐藏标题
伊朗可能在经济困境中改变战略
几个月来，伊朗一直受到美国在霍尔木兹海峡及其周边实施的海上封锁的影响。霍尔木兹海峡是世界能源供应的重要水道，自2月28日战争爆发以来，伊朗及其代理人一直扰乱霍尔木兹海峡的航运。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗战争的下一步行动一直持谨慎态度，尽管最初承诺伊朗战争只会持续几周，但现在已经进入第八个月。他表示，新的袭击不太可能发生，但他还向中东派遣了第三艘航空母舰和数千名士兵，并告诉副总统 JD 万斯，目前不需要谈判。
在美国军事保护下通过海峡运输石油的油轮帮助海湾地区的石油运输量恢复到战前的水平。与此同时，封锁限制了伊朗原油流向全球市场，从而损害了伊朗经济。
德黑兰安全分析师莫斯塔法·纳杰菲告诉美联社，伊朗的袭击可能标志着其战略的转变，此前伊朗等待袭击数月，然后针对基地的作战能力进行报复。
巴林是美国海军第五舰队的所在地，自美国和以色列于2月28日袭击伊朗以来，该舰队已经在伊朗之前的袭击中受到损害。
国际危机组织智库伊朗高级分析师哈米德雷扎·阿齐兹在发表于 X 的分析中写道，伊朗领导人现在将权衡“通过升级方式打破封锁是否比接受继续封锁的成本更低”。
“换句话说，新一轮战争的风险不再仅仅取决于特朗普是否决定再次攻击伊朗，”他说。 “这还取决于德黑兰是否认为持续克制的成本已经大于升级的风险。”
随着西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群抵达该地区，美国在波斯湾、阿拉伯海、红海和地中海的海军力量总数现已超过美国和以色列发动战争时部署的兵力。

title_en: The Nvidia Scandal Could Upend Chip Sales to China. Trump Wants to Keep Them Going
title_zh: 英伟达丑闻可能会影响对中国的芯片销售。特朗普希望让他们继续前进
summary: Commerce secretary Howard Lutnick has been under attack for not blacklisting a company caught up in the Jensen Huang scandal. But Trump is on board with the policy.
summary_zh: 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克因没有将卷入黄仁勋丑闻的公司列入黑名单而受到攻击。但特朗普也同意了
body_en: After days of political fallout from former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ’s affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, President Donald Trump is defending commerce secretary Howard Lutnick.
Last week, Lutnick came under fire from treasury secretary Scott Bessent for not aggressively imposing export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China.

But Trump’s defense of Lutnick, sources tell WIRED, reflects the president's own view that allowing the sale of some advanced AI chips to China can keep China reliant on US technology and simultaneously boost US tech stocks.

Lutnick “was doing that because if you didn’t delay it, if you didn’t do something, you could have a blowup with China. We’re having a very good relationship with China right now,” Trump said ahead of a multiday trip to Asia and a meeting on Thursday with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

Trump convened an Oval Office meeting on November 5 to discuss the political fallout from Huang’s affair with Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed executive whom some in the US government believe was recruited to spy for China, according to two sources briefed on the discussion.

Megaspeed received advanced AI chips manufactured by Nvidia through several layers of companies that started with a subsidiary of a blacklisted Chinese server conglomerate called Inspur, The New York Times has reported .

In the meeting, the sources say, Bessent confronted Lutnick, asking why Megaspeed was not added to the entity list faster, given that secretary of state Marco Rubio and US trade representative Jamieson Greer, among others, had already agreed it was the correct move.
Lutnick responded that he would defer to Trump and would add Megaspeed to the entity list if that was what the president wanted, the sources say.

But Trump settled on a third approach: for Lutnick to work on introducing a new interim trade rule to stop Chinese AI labs from using advanced AI chips remotely by leasing their compute power from data centers in Southeast Asia.

In a statement to WIRED, a White House spokesperson said the new rule would “crack down on the smuggling of advanced US SI chips” and “help ensure that America’s most advanced chips go first to US SI innovators, not Chinese shell companies.” (Superintelligence, or SI, is the administration’s term for artificial intelligence.)

A senior White House official added that Trump has been adamant that Chinese firms cannot acquire the most advanced Nvidia chips, known as Blackwells and Rubins. Those are different from the H200-type chips, built on previous-generation Hopper architecture, that Megaspeed was acquiring.

Lutnick’s position appears to have been based on a series of considerations, the sources say. For one, Megaspeed has already had the chips for months, and blacklisting the company would be akin to playing whack-a-mole unless the administration dealt with the underlying issue of Chinese firms getting remote access to US chips.

Meanwhile, Lutnick has moved cautiously on any new export restrictions—essentially waiting to get explicit approval from Trump—after he faced heavy criticism in 2025 for expanding restrictions against firms with Chinese ties, the sources said.

In September 2025, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security started aggressively using the so-called affiliates rule , which automatically extends trade restrictions to any company that is 50 percent owned by a company already on the US entity list or the military end-user list.

But the move prompted immediate retaliation by China, which suspended exports of critical rare earth metals to the US and, the sources said, prompted a wave of internal criticism accusing the Commerce Department of having sparked a trade war.

After the Busan summit at the end of October 2025, where Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping agreed to a trade truce, the White House instructed Commerce to halt the use of the affiliates rule and clear new export controls in advance, the sources said.
The suspension of the affiliates rule—which came almost as soon as it was implemented—may have had a knock-on effect on companies like Megaspeed, one person familiar with deliberations said.

Inspur, the Chinese server conglomerate connected to Megaspeed, operated a subsidiary called Aivres, which, as a California-based company, could legally buy restricted Nvidia chips without triggering direct export bans and ship them internationally to Southeast Asia.
In total, Aivres transferred billions of dollars’ worth of restricted Nvidia chips, including the powerful H200 chips, to Megaspeed’s subsidiaries.

Instead of shipping the physical chips into China, Megaspeed hosted servers at data centers in Malaysia and Indonesia—then rented out compute power to major Chinese companies. A spokesperson for Aivres said in a statement that the company complies with all US export controls.
body_zh: 在英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋与一名可疑的中国情报人员的风流韵事引发数日政治影响后，唐纳德·特朗普总统开始为商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克辩护。
上周，卢特尼克因没有积极对向中国的先进人工智能芯片实施出口限制而受到财政部长斯科特·贝森特的批评。
但消息人士告诉《连线》杂志，特朗普对卢特尼克的辩护反映了总统自己的观点，即允许向中国出售一些先进的人工智能芯片可以让中国继续依赖美国技术，同时提振美国科技股。
卢特尼克之所以这样做，是因为如果你不拖延，如果你不采取行动，你可能会与中国发生冲突。我们现在与中国有着非常好的关系，”特朗普在为期数日的亚洲之行以及周四与中国领导人习近平会晤之前表示。
据两名知情人士透露，特朗普于 11 月 5 日召开了一次椭圆形办公室会议，讨论黄与前 Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 恋情的政治影响，美国政府中的一些人认为黄爱丽是被招募来为中国从事间谍活动的。
据《纽约时报》报道，Megaspeed 通过几层公司获得了 Nvidia 制造的先进人工智能芯片，这些公司最初是被列入黑名单的中国服务器集团浪潮的子公司。
消息人士称，在会议上，贝森特与卢特尼克对峙，询问为什么没有更快地将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单中，因为国务卿马可·卢比奥和美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔等人已经同意这是正确的举动。
消息人士称，卢特尼克回应称，他会听从特朗普的意见，如果总统想要的话，他会将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单中。
但特朗普选择了第三种方法：让卢特尼克致力于引入一项新的临时贸易规则，以阻止中国人工智能实验室通过从东南亚数据中心租赁计算能力来远程使用先进的人工智能芯片。
白宫发言人在向《连线》杂志发表的一份声明中表示，新规定将“打击走私美国先进的 SI 芯片”，并“有助于确保美国最先进的芯片首先流向美国 SI 创新者，而不是中国的空壳公司。” （超级智能，或 SI，是政府对人工智能的术语。）
一位白宫高级官员补充说，特朗普一直坚持认为中国公司无法获得最先进的 Nvidia 芯片，即 Blackwells 和 Rubins。这些与 Megaspeed 正在收购的基于上一代 Hopper 架构构建的 H200 型芯片不同。
消息人士称，卢特尼克的立场似乎是基于一系列考虑。首先，Megaspeed 已经拥有这些芯片几个月了，将该公司列入黑名单就像打地鼠游戏，除非政府解决中国公司远程访问美国芯片的根本问题。
与此同时，消息人士称，卢特尼克在 2025 年因扩大对与中国有联系的企业的限制而受到严厉批评后，对任何新的出口限制都采取了谨慎的态度，基本上是在等待特朗普的明确批准。
2025 年 9 月，美国商务部工业与安全局开始积极使用所谓的关联公司规则，该规则自动将贸易限制扩大到任何已在美国实体名单或军事最终用户名单上的公司拥有 50% 股权的公司。
但消息人士称，此举立即引发了中国的报复，中国暂停了向美国出口关键稀土金属，并引发了一波内部批评，指责商务部引发了贸易战。
消息人士称，特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在 2025 年 10 月底举行的釜山峰会同意贸易休战后，白宫指示商务部停止使用附属规则，并提前清除新的出口管制。
一位知情人士表示，关联公司规则几乎在实施后就被暂停，可能对 Megaspeed 等公司产生了连锁反应。
与 Megaspeed 连接的中国服务器集团浪潮运营着一家名为 Aivres 的子公司，这家总部位于加州的公司可以合法购买受限制的 Nvidia 芯片，而不会触发直接出口禁令，并将其运往东南亚。
Aivres 总共将价值数十亿美元的受限制的 Nvidia 芯片（包括功能强大的 H200 芯片）转移给了 Megaspeed 的子公司。
Megaspeed 没有将物理芯片运送到中国，而是在马来西亚和印度尼西亚的数据中心托管服务器，然后将计算能力出租给中国主要公司。艾夫雷斯发言人在一份声明中表示，该公司遵守美国的所有出口管制。
